This '''[[Rancor/Legends|Rancor]] ornament''' adorned the interior of Jabba's sail barge, the [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']]. It was situated between two windows.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
This statue was first seen in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], in which it appeared adorning the interior of Jabba the Hutt's personal sail barge the ''Khetanna''.<ref name="ROTJ" /> It can be seen in the background of promotional photos from the film.<ref name="Creating">''[[Creating the Worlds of Star Wars: 365 Days]]''</ref> A lightened, more detailed image of the bronze sculpture can be seen in a continuity photo taken on the set of the film.<ref name="Making" />

In [[2022]], the company [[Regal Robot]] released a corbel/wall decoration and a magnet based on the sculpture.<ref name="Regal Robot">{{WebCite|url=https://regalrobot.com/shop/star-wars/starwars-art-sculpture-decor/rancor-corbel-sculpture-wall-decor/|title=Rancor Corbel 18″ Wall Decor Sculpture|work=Regal Robot|archivedate=20250823233325}}</ref> The ornament could also been seen in the ''Khetanna'' toy from [[Hasbro]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Vintage Collection]]''.<ref name="TVC">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Vintage Collection|pack=Jabba's Sail Barge (The Khetanna)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/Jabbas-Sail-Barge-Khetanna-Hasbro-Haslab-Vintage-Collection.asp}}</ref>
